| R5 | Route/charge accounting — per-call accounting refs + route-decision fact rows | `hh-eval::{facts, accounting}` |

| R11 | `test_profile` — V1–V9; `ProfileTestReport` versioned content-addressed | `hh-compiler::profile_test` |

## Changes

- **`hh-gateway`** — `probes.rs` (new): transport-declaration probes
  (`probe_capability` port method, `run_transport_probes` folding
  observed vs pinned), fingerprint probe (`run_fingerprint_probe` /
  `FingerprintProbeSpec` / honest-unknown verdict), `describe` +
  `discovery_conformance` producing `ConformanceRecord`s (hh-registry)
  with instrument-charged calls, `SnapshotClaim` on substitution/fingerprint
  drift. `gateway.rs`: `stamp_participant` on every emitted row (hosted
  normalization), the substitution gate (`served_model_mismatch`
  terminal), `charge_model` (charge keyed at served). `plan.rs`:
  `substitution_allowed`/`participant_class` request members.
  `router.rs`: `check_reroute_order` + the closed `RerouteOrderError`
  sum. `cache.rs`: invalidation/observation halves.
  `tests/golden_streams.rs` (new, 13): the 13-shape golden corpus × 2
  dialects, substitution/drift/hosted/invalidation fixtures.
  `Cargo.toml`: + `hh-registry` (conformance records — gateway →
  registry read view, plane-legal).
- **`hh-context`** — `k5.rs` (new): the K5 exact-match response cache —
  admissibility, hit serves with the `served_from_cache` terminal stamp,
  revocation withholds, dependency-stamp drift marks stale, one
  `k5.resolved` row per lookup. `vocab.rs`/`lib.rs`: exports.
- **`hh-compiler`** — `profile_test.rs` (new): the V1–V9 validity
  battery, `ProfileTestReport` (versioned, content-addressed), probe
  verdicts, `retire_rule` (the `P − R` reduced profile). `link.rs`: the
  report-at-link gate (`ProfileUntested`/`ProfileInvalid`/
  `CapabilityDrift`; null profile exempt), `fallback_used` on the bound
  profile, `test_report_ref` on the bundle. `schema.rs`: `test_reports`
  on the wire `CompileInputs` (the OOP `hh-compile` binary carries the
  bound views). `profile.rs`: `RetireError` + retire support.
- **`hh-ontology`** — `eval.rs`: `Design` gains `routing_policy`
  (`fail_fast` default), `deviation_policy`, `cache_na_stratified` —
  additive members with decode defaults.
- **`hh-eval`** — `facts.rs`: the `LedgerFacts` projection over the
  model-plane rows. `accounting.rs` (new): `model_accounting` → closed
  `AccountingViolation` sum. `compare.rs`: `DeviationReport`,
  `outcome_counts`, `ReplayedTrajectory`/`DeviationUnderFailFast`/
  `UnstratifiedDeviation` refusals, `removal_verdict` +
  `RemovalOutcome`. `compliance.rs`: `profile_rule_followed_rates`.
  `runs.rs`: `EvalRun` gains `routing_deviation`/`replayed_trajectory`.
- **`hh-lab`** — `experiment.rs`: `ArmSpec.response_cache` closed sum,
  `SpecContext.cache_state_visible` resolver, registration refusals
  (`NotARetirementMatch`, `PreRegistrationInvalid`, natural-on-invisible).
- **`hh-experiment`** — engine halves for the new registration gates.
- **`hh-telemetry`** — `genai.rs` (new): GenAI span lowering —
  `gen_ai.usage.cache_read/write.input_tokens` carried, every
  nonrepresentable member a named loss entry.
- **`hh-embed` / `hh-analysis` / `hh-results`** — literal-site updates
  for the new `Design`/`EvalRun`/`ArmSpec` members.
